def frame_obj(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('p','W') and 40<=n['pixels']<=120 and 15<=n['boundary'][0][0]<55:
            b=n['boundary']
            return (n['color'],n['pixels'],min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    return None
print('before', frame_obj(current_frame))
action(['DOWN'])
print('after DOWN', frame_obj(current_frame), last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
</parameter>
</function>
